branches.title: Uncertainty Quantification in Control: NN vs GP
branches.purpose: To identify how Gaussian Process uncertainty estimation differs from neural network approaches and what lessons can be drawn for robust control design.
branches.query: Comparison of uncertainty quantification methods in neural networks versus Gaussian processes for model predictive control

branches.title: Architectural Inspirations from Deep Learning for GP Controllers
branches.purpose: To find recent neural network architectures or training strategies that could inspire improvements in scalable or deep Gaussian process models for control tasks.
branches.query: Deep learning inspired architectures and training strategies for scalable Gaussian process regression in control theory

branches.title: Hybrid NN-GP Approaches in Adaptive Control
branches.purpose: To explore existing hybrid frameworks where neural networks handle high-dimensional features while GPs manage residual dynamics or safety constraints, providing a template for GP-centric research.
branches.query: Hybrid neural network and Gaussian process frameworks for adaptive control and reinforcement learning
